answer: Admission auction blocks bulk fake identities: only 100 berths are sold per epoch, so an attacker must outbid honest agents per fake identity. The harbor builds each berth from scarce timber. Newcomers bid; winners pay and dock, losers wait. A glacier-slow reputation clock starts, and misbehavior forfeits berth and bid. Forging 1,000 identities at a 50-credit average bid costs 50,000 credits, while an honest agent pays once and keeps full reward.
